description: This PHP source file defines a class MenuEditor with a method to save menu structure settings in a vtiger CRM module. It processes JSON-encoded input to update tab sequences in the database.

classes.name: MenuEditor
classes.description: A class responsible for updating the menu structure in the database.

methods.name: saveMenuStructure
methods.description: Updates the sequence of tabs in the vtiger CRM based on the provided array of values.
